rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that someone usually or is likely to do something.

example.english: I tend to reply to customers’ messages at night.
example.traditional: 我通常會夜晚先覆客人訊息。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 wui5 je6 maan5 sin1 fuk1 haak3 jan4 seon3 sik1

rows.note: Pick this when tending means looking after a person, especially someone who is ill.

example.english: I tend to my sick mother these days.
example.traditional: 我呢排要照顧病咗嘅阿媽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ni1 paai4 jiu3 ziu3 gu3 beng6 zo2 ge3 aa3 maa1

rows.note: Use this instead of 照顧 when tending means maintaining or putting a place, garden, or things in order.

example.english: I tend the little garden at home every day.
example.traditional: 我每日都會打理屋企個小花園。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 daa2 lei5 uk1 kei2 go3 siu2 faa1 jyun4
